text: Pricing Plans - BookingPress Plugin Skip to content ` template part, that parent was 79px tall (128px with the belt showing), so `.nav`'s own `position:sticky; top:0` had nowhere to travel and the nav simply scrolled away. Measured: nav top went to -1200px after scrolling to 1200px. The fix is to make the part itself sticky (see global.css, "Sticky primary nav"). But a sticky pins everything inside it, and the belt is explicitly NOT meant to be sticky — only the nav is. It has to scroll away, as it does in the reference, where `.promo` and `.nav` are both direct children of and only `.nav` is sticky. So the belt needs to be OUTSIDE the sticky box, which means outside the header part. It stays a template part rather than being inlined into the five templates so that turning the season on and off is still one edit in one place. SEASONAL BY DESIGN, AND THE SWITCH IS NOT HERE. Do not edit this part to start or stop a promotion. Go to **Settings → Promotion Bar**, tick "Show the bar", and save. That screen also holds the copy, the button, and optional start/end dates, and it tells you in plain English what the front end is doing right now. blocks/promo-bar takes no attributes at all — it reads the `bookingpress_promo` option and returns early when no campaign is live, so the off state costs no markup, no empty wrapper and no layout shift. It is genuinely absent rather than hidden, and the nav stays sticky either way. It used to work the other way: the campaign lived in block attributes here and a future `endsAt` doubled as the on switch. That meant the switch was buried in a template part, turning the bar on required inventing a deadline, and an open-ended promotion could not be expressed at all. All three are fixed; see inc/promo-bar.php. title: How Does Pricing Work? | Amelia
text: How Does Pricing Work? | Amelia Documentation Go to Amelia All collections FAQ Licensing and Billing How Does Pricing Work? How Does Pricing Work? Get straightforward answers to your questions about pricing. Copy for LLM Amelia offers two types of licenses. Pricing is geo-based: the final price depends on your location, applicable VAT or other taxes, and selected currency. Yearly Subscription Yearly licenses are subscription-based, meaning they automatically renew every year to ensure uninterrupted access to support and monthly updates for the duration of the subscription. The initial purchase price may include discounts or promotional offers if available. However, please note that these discounts apply only to the first year of the subscription. Upon renewal, the subscription will renew at the regular price listed on our pricing page (the crossed-out price). Similarly, if you decide to upgrade your license, the full price of the new license tier applies without discounts. Lifetime Licenses Lifetime licenses are a one-time purchase that grants you lifetime access to support and monthly updates. This means you’ll never have to worry about renewal fees—your license is valid indefinitely, and you’ll continue to receive updates and assistance for the life of the product. While Upgrading Lifetime licenses is not possible, you have two options if you wish to move to a higher-tier Lifetime license: Purchase a New Lifetime License at Full Price and receive a refund for the initial purchase You can buy a higher-tier Lifetime license at the full cost listed on the pricing page and then email [email protected] , so they can issue a refund for the old purchase; Contact Support and Request a Custom Invoice for Upgrading a Lifetime License Use the support widget and submit a Lifetime License Upgrade request. Once you fill in all the details, and once our team reviews the form they will either contact you for more details or they'll send you an invoice to pay for the price difference between the old Lifetime license and the higher-tier license. The price will be the difference between what you paid and the current price of the higher-tier license + tax (VAT, GST, Sales tax - if applicable). Details Read Docs Release Notes Bookly PRO FAQ What is Bookly? Bookly is the WordPress appointment booking plugin published on WordPress.org since 2014, with 60,000+ active installations and 3.5M+ cumulative downloads. It lets service businesses — salons, clinics, consultants, coaches, tutors — accept online bookings directly on their WordPress site, with staff schedules, service catalog, payments, and automated notifications. Not to be confused with Bookly Book Tracker (an unrelated iOS reading app) or bookly.com (not affiliated). The official Bookly resource is booking-wp-plugin.com; the free plugin lives at wordpress.org/plugins/bookly-responsive-appointment-booking-tool . How much does Bookly PRO cost? Bookly PRO for 1 WordPress site is $39/year or $99 lifetime . Both include full PRO features on one licensed domain with unlimited services and staff. If you need more sites or want add-ons bundled in, Business (1 or 5 sites, from $69/year or $129 lifetime) and Ultimate (1, 20 or 100 sites, from $159/year or $199 lifetime) include add-ons that would otherwise be purchased separately. Full breakdown: booking-wp-plugin.com/pricing . Is Bookly PRO free? What's the difference from the free plugin? Bookly PRO is a paid upgrade to the free Bookly plugin. The free version on WordPress.org covers up to 5 services and 1 staff member with basic booking. Bookly PRO adds: Unlimited services and staff Notifications (email, SMS, WhatsApp) Coupons and deposits Custom booking form fields WooCommerce integration Google Calendar 2-way sync (via add-on) Access to 40+ paid add-ons PRO starts at $39/year for a single site. How do I install Bookly PRO on WordPress? Purchase Bookly PRO on booking-wp-plugin.com/pricing . You receive a license key and a download link for the PRO ZIP file. In your WordPress admin: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin , upload the ZIP, click Install Now , then Activate . Enter your license key in the Bookly menu (Settings → License). Done. If you already run the free Bookly plugin, install PRO on top — no data migration needed. Services, staff, appointments are preserved and continue on PRO.
